projects.description: Configuration and validation scaffold for a planned local career-page monitor with resume matching and Discord alerts. Current source provides typed configuration and job/evaluation records, TOML path resolution, URL normalization, exact-host allowlisting, and public-address checks. Collection, matching, notification delivery, and the declared CLI entry point are not implemented in the current source.

projects.description: ESP32 PC power-button controller with the existing Wi-Fi/MQTT setup and saved profiles, one-second power commands, configurable long press, startup locking, authenticated LAN PC-presence polling, active-buzzer rhythms and hourly chimes. Includes a standard-library PC presence API and a local MQTT GUI/CLI. API silence means unknown power state; physical PC shutdown depends on OS button settings. Versioned full-device backups are encrypted before Git archival; a recovery tool authenticates and verifies images using an external recovery key.
